purpose: Fill the current integration overview with a new 600-second tsukumijima/main baseline measured under the same low-overhead conditions as the current integration.

conditions.instrumentation: Per-second rAF/rVFC aggregation and deinterlacer stats; no WebGL method wrapping.
conditions.comparisonNote: Both runs cover the same known-good cadence interval. Their measured starts differ by 0.366 seconds.

baseline.konomiPlayerChanges: Measurement exposure hook only; pictureWorkers uses the player default of 4 on this device.

integration.konomiPlayerChanges: The same measurement exposure hook plus explicit pictureWorkers=4, equal to the player default on this device.

calculation.yadifGeneratedFieldsPerSecond: (last filtered - first filtered) / (last stats timestamp - first stats timestamp)
calculation.counterDelta: last stats counter - first stats counter
calculation.rafAndVideoCallbackPerSecond: sum of per-second bin counts / measured wall duration

interpretation.steadyState: Both builds maintained the theoretical 59.94 generated fields per second and recorded zero missed fields over 600 seconds.
interpretation.scope: The queue changes improve seek recovery and injected overflow behavior; this normal steady-state comparison shows no loss and no material gain in generated-field throughput.
interpretation.displayLimit: This low-overhead collector did not wrap WebGL draw calls. The rate is generated YADIF fields, not a direct count of final canvas draws.
